name: Bash

input.command:
git mv app/composables/useCart.ts app/composables/useShoppingCart.ts
sed -i '' "s/Overrides the base layer's legacy \`useCart\`\./Replaces the base layer's legacy \`useCart\`./; s/export function useCart()/export function useShoppingCart()/" app/composables/useShoppingCart.ts
for f in app/middleware/cart-not-empty.ts app/composables/useCartTotal.ts app/components/cart/Item.vue app/components/cart/Badge.vue app/pages/cart.vue "app/pages/products/[slug].vue"; do sed -i '' 's/\buseCart()/useShoppingCart()/g; s/[[:<:]]useCart()/useShoppingCart()/g' "$f"; done
grep -rn "useCart\b\|useCart(" app; grep -rn "useShoppingCart" app; git status --short
